settings.logo_info: Optional. If left blank, the shop name is shown as a wordmark, matching the ARDEA demo.

settings.palette_info: These default to the fixed ARDEA brand tokens (Sand / Terracotta / Deep Olive / Charcoal Brown / Cream) used throughout the master design. Adjust only if you intend to depart from the brand guidelines.

settings.free_shipping_threshold_info: Amount at which the free-delivery progress bar in the cart drawer/cart page reaches 100%. The ARDEA demo uses ₹6,000.

settings.wishlist_info: Shopify has no native wishlist object. Wishlist state is stored client-side in the shopper's browser via localStorage, keyed by product handle.
